accounting_scope: All NanoGPT proposer responses with explicit pricing metadata found under research/vero-v3/results; this is conservative R&D proposer spend, not total human/orchestrator/compute cost.
limitations: The ledger excludes unmetered Codex orchestration, human research time, local CPU time, and electricity.
Development cost is not directly comparable to a one-pass benchmark inference budget.
Zero scoring-replay cost means the frozen extracted artifacts require no model call to reproduce; it does not mean the research campaign used no models.
